result.summary: The page is largely well-structured. One notable visual defect: the third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its title clipped by the right screen edge. Per instructions, edge-clipping in a horizontally scrollable carousel is treated as a feature, not a defect. No other visually broken elements were found; layout, contrast, and alignment are consistent.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is truncated at the right viewport edge. While this is expected behavior for a horizontal carousel, the truncation occurs mid-word without an ellipsis, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than intentional scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Apply a proper text-overflow ellipsis or add right-edge padding/fade mask to the carousel so clipped titles read as scrollable content rather than broken text.
